'''Numinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] fleet [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]'s [[Fifth Assault Fleet]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He spearheaded the creation of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron, a Republic task force composed of scattered individuals striking at Imperial targets across the galaxy. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound]] impersonated the admiral after a terminal malfunction at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]].

In [[3643 BBY]], Numinn gathered with Supreme Commander [[Rans]] and General [[Elin Garza]] at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to meet with the commander of [[Havoc Squad]] in order to discuss the Republic upcoming assault against the Imperial superweapon, [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]]. However, before they could initiate the operation, Garza felt that Havoc Squad needed to be expanded and ordered the Havoc CO to recruit [[Tanno Vik|two more]] [[Yuun|specialists]] required for the mission.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Return to Duty|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref> 

Once the expanded Havoc returned to Coruscant, Numinn detailed the plan for both [[Havoc Squad's BT-7 Thunderclap]] and his own fleet to make numerous short hyperjumps well below the minimum time it would take the Gauntlet to lock onto them. However, this would deplete their fuel, keeping the fleet from retreating until they accomplished the mission. Numinn's fleet would buy Havoc time to infiltrate and destroy the superweapon. Following the success of the mission, Numinn gathered with the rest of his colleagues back at the Senate Tower and watched as Garza commended Havoc Squad and promoted their CO to the rank of Major.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Return to Duty|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Ilum]], Numinn was part of the emergency war council convened to take action against [[Darth Malgus]] and his [[New Empire]]. Numinn believed that Malgus would focus only on his former Imperial comrades, only for General [[Elin Garza]] to remind him of the Sith's crimes during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Battle">{{TORcite|type=Flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}}</ref>

Amid the [[third Galactic War]] in [[3627 BBY]], Numinn participated in the defense of the newly constructed Republic shipyard known as the [[Meridian Complex]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when Darth Malgus launched a large-scale [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|invasion]] in an attempt to destroy it.<ref name="ObjectiveMeridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=Flashpoint|Objective: Meridian}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
When first arriving on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Smuggler will slice into the identification terminal, causing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to greet them as "Admiral Numinn" regardless of race.
